about: The source model of a DICOM Part 10 file (spec/virtualize/dicom.md): the elements a parser emits, the transfer syntaxes and photometric interpretations the convention admits, and the roles the file, an attribute, the image, its pixel data and each frame play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the DICOM convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses, at the point the profile meets each role; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing. The structure of the data elements (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §6.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#61-elements>–§6.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#63-datasets-and-sequences>: headers, VRs, lengths, items, delimiters, depth) is the binary layer, which the parser's code checks.

syntaxes.about: Transfer Syntax UID: the dataset's encoding and the codec of encapsulated frames (none: native)

photometrics.about: by codec and Samples per Pixel

elements.about: The IR of a DICOM file (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#5-source-metadata>). <tag> is a tag as 8 uppercase hexadecimal digits; E the dataset's byte order. An element of defined length that is not a sequence is one value, a record of its header and `v`, its value typed by its VR. `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run.

meta.about: the File Meta Information: its elements, as a dataset's

dataset.about: the top-level dataset: its elements to Pixel Data, Pixel Data, and the elements after it

<dataset>/<tag>.about: the first element of a tag in its dataset. A value of type {group:Eu2,element:Eu2,vr:ascii[2],length:Eu2,v:T} (explicit VR), {group:Eu2,element:Eu2,vr:ascii[2],reserved:Eu2,length:Eu4,v:T} (explicit VR with a 4-byte length) or {group:Eu2,element:Eu2,length:Eu4,v:T} (implicit VR); T by the VR (the dictionary's when the file states none): cstr[n] for text, Eu2[k,2] for AT, Ef4[k], Ef8[k], Ei4[k], Ei2[k], Eu4[k], Eu2[k], Ei8[k], Eu8[k] for numbers, else bytes[n]. A sequence (and a sequence of defined length that parses) is a struct: `header`, its items, `end` (undefined length).

<dataset>/duplicates/<k>/<tag>.about: the k-th later element of a tag already in its dataset, in file order

dataset/7FE00010.about: the top-level Pixel Data: `header`; native: `frames/<f>` (data, a run when the frames are contiguous), `padding` (one 00 byte); encapsulated: `offset_table` (`header`, `offsets` Eu4[k]), `fragment_headers/<j>` and `fragments/<j>` (data), `end`

pixel_extra.type: bytes: native pixel data past the frames

pixel_unreferenced/<k>.type: bytes: before the k-th frame's item, in order of offset (Extended Offset Table)

trailing.type: bytes: from where the elements after Pixel Data stop to the end

given.syntax: the first string value of (0002,0010), or absent

attribute.about: an attribute of spec/virtualize/dicom.md §2.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#22-attributes> present where it is read (length not 0)

given.vr: its VR, absent in implicit VR

given.whole: its length is a multiple of n

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: the walk of the data elements (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §6.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#61-elements>–§6.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#63-datasets-and-sequences>), which rejects the structures it walks that break a rule; attribute values by kind (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §2.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#22-attributes>: strings split at 5C and trimmed, decimals, integer strings); the frames of native and encapsulated pixel data (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §6.5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#65-frames>: the fragments by the Extended or Basic Offset Table); the VOI window; and the root's source metadata (spec/virtualize/dicom.md §5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/dicom.md#5-source-metadata>), which never rejects.
